claims.title: Microdevice renewal: retained electrical isolation and interior service access

quoted_fields.interface: Eight-sector optical head: 56 functional parts, 136 specified terminal-to-net joins on 43 nets, 32 submillimetre passives plus eight qualifying amplifiers, nominal complete 24.9 mm cube. Three noncoplanar layouts share component stock and a paid external instrument. Individual component ownership, electrical opening, diagnosis, tool capture, full extraction route, reconnection, installed functional proof and return-to-ready are distinct operations.
quoted_fields.failure: The mechanism is a design and executable route/campaign report, not a fabricated apparatus. Rigid-envelope collision screens omit some flexible wires, deflection and continuous tool motion. Maker points do not qualify custom contacts, ceramic recovery, force distribution, photodiode/LED operating point or high-impedance leakage. Probe force can alter the measured contact. The matched conventional construction receives equal geometry, access and automatic test. Neither threefold complete speed nor 30% cost improvement is achieved; proposed physical experiments are unexecuted.
